title_cyr: Да ти пукне мила мајко најмилото
title_latin: Da ti pukne mila majko najmiloto
title_en: May What You Hold Dearest Burst, Dear Mother
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Варош' is a place name (probably a district of Prilep, my guess); 'Митриќевци' is probably a family or household name. The last stanza ('сум каснала кај мајка ми') is my reading: they said I had already eaten at my mother's house.

lines.cyr: Да ти пукне мила мајко најмилото,
lines.lat: Da ti pukne mila majko najmiloto,
lines.en: May what you hold dearest burst, dear mother,

lines.cyr: што ме даде, мила мајко, пусти Варош.
lines.lat: što me dade, mila majko, pusti Varoš.
lines.en: for giving me away, dear mother, to wretched Varosh.

lines.cyr: Оф, леле, леле, леле, пусти Варош,
lines.lat: Of, lele, lele, lele, pusti Varoš,
lines.en: Oh, alas, alas, alas, wretched Varosh,

lines.cyr: оф, аман, оф аманам, пусти Варош.
lines.lat: of, aman, of amanam, pusti Varoš.
lines.en: oh, aman, oh amanam, wretched Varosh.

lines.cyr: Пусти Варош, мила мамо, кај Митриќевци,
lines.lat: Pusti Varoš, mila mamo, kaj Mitriḱevci,
lines.en: Wretched Varosh, dear mama, at the Mitrikjevci's,
the Mitrikjevci's, dear mama, many people.

lines.cyr: Оф, леле, леле, леле, многу луѓе,

lines.lat: of aman, of amanam, mnogu luǵe.
lines.en: oh aman, oh amanam, many people.

lines.cyr: Сум месила, мила мамо, девет зелници,
lines.lat: Sum mesila, mila mamo, devet zelnici,
lines.en: I had kneaded, dear mama, nine pies,
